description: Investigates privacy-preserving distributed machine learning algorithms, non-IID optimization, differential privacy, Byzantine robustness, and federated edge architectures.
learning_objectives: Understand cross-silo and cross-device federated learning architectures and non-IID data challenges.
Master federated optimization algorithms including FedAvg, FedProx, and SCAFFOLD.
Apply differential privacy, secure multi-party computation, and homomorphic encryption in FL.
Defend against model poisoning, backdoor attacks, and optimize communication efficiency.
outline: Federated Learning Foundations: Core concepts, motivations, cross-silo vs. cross-device architectures, non-IID client distributions.
Federated Optimization: FedAvg, FedProx, FedNova, SCAFFOLD, convergence analysis under heterogeneous settings.
Privacy & Cryptographic Security: Differential privacy (Local/Central DP), Secure Multi-Party Computation (SMPC), Homomorphic Encryption.
Poisoning & Robustness: Byzantine attacks, model poisoning, backdoor attacks, robust aggregation rules (Krum, Coordinate-wise Median, Trimmed Mean).
Communication Efficiency: Model compression, quantization, sparsification, split learning, asynchronous federated learning.
Frameworks & Edge Deployment: PySyft, Flower, TensorFlow Federated (TFF), real-world case studies in healthcare and finance.
